leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue composable function to track in-flight requests
Apply request deduplication logic to prevent duplicate API calls
Construct a reactive state object to manage pending request status
Configure computed properties to determine if a request is already in progress
Integrate the deduplication mechanism with existing API service calls
Manipulate the request tracking state when requests start and complete
Render UI feedback based on the deduplication status
